scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Applicant must be a non-pensioner ex-serviceman or his widow
Applicant should be of rank Havildar/equivalent and below
Applicant should be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB)
Expenditure must be incurred at recognized government hospitals at rates approved under CGHS/ECHS
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to Rs.30,000 per year per eligible ex-serviceman or widow.
documents_required: Supporting documents attested by the Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO)
